The '''SB4 shortened barrel''' was a model of [[shortened barrel]] produced by [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]] and sold for 250 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. Only compatible with [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]], the attachment was available in the period after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
